versos.e: Sends flesh to the Israelites in consequence of their murmuring Ex 16:12
Indulges Moses’ prayer to behold his glory Ex 33:18-23
.Sets forth his reasons for sending the flood Ge 6:11-13
Enters into covenant with Abraham Ge 15:1-21; 18:1-22
Indulges Abraham’s intercession for Sodom Ge 18:23-33
Warns Abimelech in a dream Ge 20:3-7
Invites sinners, saying, “Come now, and let us reason together,” Isa 1:18-20
